description: Supraspinatus hides in the supraspinous fossa yet lifts the humeral head into abduction, setting the deltoid's outer sweep.
actions: Initiates the first degrees of shoulder abduction before the deltoid takes over.
Compresses the humeral head into the glenoid, protecting the joint during overhead work.
Shapes a subtle triangular fullness above the scapular spine when the arm is active.
